note: In the Qu'Appelle Valley between Echo and Pasqua Lakes. Lakeview A and B lie along the Echo Lake road, with private cottages between them and the water; Valleyview, Lookout Point and Hidden Coulee sit on the valley slope and Aspen on the upland; Morningview holds the full-service sites. Many Lakeview B sites take less than 23 ft; the upland loops take 32-50 ft. About 60 Valleyview sites are seasonal. --Claude
